title: Short-Horizon Sparse Model Predictive Control for Precipitation Reduction Using Numerical Weather Prediction
summary: This study proposes a precipitation control framework integrating a realistic Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) model with model predictive control (MPC). At each control instant in MPC, a finite-difference sensitivity matrix is constructed from the NWP model and used as a local linear model of how perturbations to the atmospheric state affect future precipitation. A sparse convex optimization problem is then solved to compute the control input, which is implemented as a perturbation to the atmospheric state.
